text:
haley-peopleops: Heads-up: manager submitted promo packet today for Samir (IC4 -> IC5) but forgot the signed justification form. We have payroll cutoff on Tue. Who should I loop in to keep this from stalling?
elena-peopleops: Thanks for flagging. If it missed the evidence window we treat it as an exception. Please attach what you have to an appeals ticket and ping promo-appeals@people-ops. We need manager attestation, peer corroboration, and any 1:1 notes you can share. Short attestation is fine. :ok_hand:
jorge-eng-mgr: cc @haley-peopleops @elena-peopleops 12 I uploaded the attestation and two peer blurbs to the ticket. Can we still include this in the current run or is it going to next cycle?
elena-peopleops: Depends on timing. If we get the signed justification + manager attestation + group lead sign-off within 48 hours we can try to add it to the current payroll. Otherwise it moves to the next cycle and may be eligible for retro pay with Sr People Ops + Finance approval.
priya-manager: Quick Q: what exactly needs to be in the manager attestation? Do you have a template?
elena-peopleops: No strict template. Please cover: 1) scope of impact (projects/customers), 2) evidence of sustained or accelerated impact, 3) reason it missed the window, 4) sign-off from manager + group lead. A short paragraph hitting those bullets is sufficient. Confluence has the example template: https://confluence.redwood/promo-evidence-template
mark-recruiter: I can upload offer letter + original comp rationale to the ticket if that helps Finance context.
haley-peopleops: Yes please attach offer and comp sheet. Ill forward to promo-appeals once attachments are in.
people-ops-bot: Promo Appeals ticket created: PA-2026-108. Owner assigned: elena-peopleops. Please update ticket with payroll cutoff if urgent.
jorge-eng-mgr: Uploaded offer & comp spreadsheet to PA-2026-108. One ask: if we seek retro to hire date, how long does Finance usually take to process?
elena-peopleops: Finance turnaround for retro pay is roughly 7 business days after approvals. If payroll cutoff is in 2 days it likely won't make that run. We'll escalate for retention-critical cases.
priya-manager: Is there a formal appeals cutoff after the cycle ends?
elena-peopleops: We accept appeals up to 90 days post-cycle close; best chance is within 2 weeks. After 90 days it becomes an ad-hoc review with more evidence required.
haley-peopleops: Manager says signed justification will be uploaded within 24 hours. If we make the 48hr window, should I escalate to VP People Ops or let promo-appeals triage first?
elena-peopleops: Let promo-appeals triage initially. Escalate to VP People Ops only if retention risk or legal/compliance concern. I'll also ping Finance to flag the ticket in case of tight cutoff.
mark-recruiter: Signed justification and offer doc uploaded to PA-2026-108.
people-ops-bot: PA-2026-108 status: Under review by elena-peopleops. Reminder: add payroll deadline if urgent.
haley-peopleops: Added payroll cutoff 2026-05-12 and marked urgent. Will report back here when we hear from Finance.
elena-peopleops: Thanks team. If Finance needs anything else Ill loop in payroll and VP. Keep updates in the ticket.
haley-peopleops: Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
